semantics.definition: Our astroid as its body, a round ring lying in each of its four curved sides with one round join to the body, a fan that turns in each ring, and on its body four studs other pieces are set on. Red, with matte black rings and glossy black fans.
semantics.responsibility: Be the one drone every No Origins app uses. It changes only through a proposal you approve; Mero keeps the fingerprints of the version you approved, git keeps the code.

spec.job: Fly round the world and hover, carrying what is set on its studs.

state.landed: standing on its place, its fans still
state.hovering: hanging over its place, rising and sinking a little, its fans turning
state.flying: flying round its place, leaning into its way, its fans turning faster
